criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or transaction on the account that the customer did not make or does not recognise (an unknown charge, a merchant name they don't know), even if they ask for a refund. A small extra amount on the statement is extra_charge_on_statement instead.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash/ATM withdrawal showing in the app or on the account that the customer did not make, did not receive, or does not recognise.
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: Any direct debit problem: a direct debit the customer does not recognise, did not authorise, wants to dispute, or wants a refund on.
criteria.compromised_card: Customer thinks their card or account has been compromised, hacked, or used by someone else; unusual activity; wants to freeze it.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card is lost or stolen now; reporting it; what to do; replacing a lost/stolen card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost, left somewhere or stolen; protecting the account/app after losing the phone.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot or needs to reset the app passcode; cannot log in to the app with the passcode.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Charged twice / duplicate charge for the same purchase.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave less cash or the wrong amount, or the customer could not get the cash amount they wanted/requested even though the withdrawal went through.
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for a purchase or item from a merchant, or to cancel an order/purchase of goods and get money back; how to dispute a transaction.
criteria.refund_not_showing_up: A refund from a merchant has not appeared yet.
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A payment or ATM transaction was reverted, cancelled or returned by the app, the bank or the merchant without the customer asking; the payment 'came back'.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An extra fee, extra small amount (e.g. a £1 charge) or paying more than the price, showing on the statement; the customer asks why it is there. If they say the fee came from paying by card / buying something, withdrawing cash, transferring or topping up, it is fee_question instead.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_applied: A wrong or unfair exchange rate was applied to an actual purchase or ATM cash withdrawal abroad the customer made.
criteria.activate_card: How to activate a new card.
criteria.card_arrival_delivery: When a new card will arrive, delivery time, tracking, card not arrived yet, delivery to a country, the customer demanding to get their card quickly.
criteria.order_card: Ordering a physical card, a new/replacement card, additional or spare cards, cards for family.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring; getting a renewal.
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card to the app; making a card show up in the app; reactivating or re-adding a card the customer found after reporting it lost.
criteria.change_pin: Changing or finding the PIN; where to change the PIN.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked or card blocked after wrong PIN entries.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing card network.
criteria.virtual_card: Getting a virtual card or disposable virtual card, how they work, their limits; virtual card not working.
criteria.card_not_working_declined: Card not working; a card payment or purchase declined or denied, even after several attempts; card rejected at a shop or online.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM refused the withdrawal; could not get cash from the ATM; card declined at ATM.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending or has not gone through.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal still shows as pending, has not shown up, or the balance does not look right after an ATM withdrawal.
criteria.card_acceptance_atm_support: Where the card is accepted, which ATMs take it, using the card in other countries, card spending limits, contactless not working.
criteria.transfer_not_received: A transfer sent has not arrived at the recipient.
criteria.transfer_timing_pending: How long transfers take; a transfer is still pending.
criteria.failed_or_declined_transfer: A bank transfer (sending money to another account or person) failed or was declined; can't add or name a beneficiary; can't transfer to a beneficiary or crypto exchange. A card declined when buying something is card_not_working_declined instead.
criteria.cancel_transfer: The customer wants to cancel or revert a transfer or transaction they sent themselves (e.g. 'how can I cancel this transaction', 'I need to cancel a transfer'), or fix a payment sent to the wrong account. Not for cancelling an order/purchase of goods (request_refund) and not for a payment that was cancelled or reverted by itself (reverted_card_payment).
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account from another bank; receiving money; SWIFT/SEPA; whether a credit card can be used to make a transfer.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_transfer: A bank transfer into the account has not shown in the balance.
criteria.topping_up: How to top up (by card, bank transfer, cash, cheque, Apple Pay/Google Pay), auto top-up, top-up limits.
criteria.top_up_problem: A top-up failed, is pending, was reverted, or the money did not appear.
criteria.cheque_or_cash_deposit_not_showing: A cheque or cash deposit has not shown in the balance.
criteria.fee_question: Questions or complaints about fees for a service, including a fee charged when buying something or paying by card, an ATM withdrawal fee, transfer fee, top-up fee, fee for receiving money, or for ordering a card.
criteria.exchange_rate_info: How exchange rates are set, what rate the customer will get, exchange fees.
criteria.currency_exchange: How to exchange currencies in the app; which currencies are supported for holding and exchanging.
criteria.verify_identity: Identity verification: documents needed, why it's needed, verification failing, app not recognising the customer.
criteria.verify_top_up: Top-up verification code or why a top-up must be verified.
criteria.source_of_funds: Verifying the source of funds; money appearing that the customer did not add.
criteria.age_country_eligibility: Age limits, which countries the bank/account is available in, who can open an account.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, international cards) or currencies are accepted or supported for topping up, holding money or exchanging. Using a credit card to send a transfer is transfer_into_account instead.

members.name: routing_v8b
members.instructions:
You route messages sent to a digital bank's customer support chat. Read the customer's message and decide which one of the listed customer issues it describes; choose the closest match.
Routing rules:
- Transactions or charges the customer did not make or does not recognise are fraud issues, even when they ask for a refund. Any direct debit dispute or refund request is direct_debit_not_recognised.
- An extra small amount or fee on the statement ('why is there a £1 charge', 'I paid one pound more') is extra_charge_on_statement.
- Fees for a service (paying by card, buying, ATM withdrawals, transfers, top-ups) are fee_question; a question about an extra fee/charge on the statement without saying where it came from is extra_charge_on_statement.
- A wrong exchange rate on an actual purchase or withdrawal is wrong_exchange_rate_applied; general questions about rates are exchange_rate_info.
- Questions about which cards or currencies are supported (including for top-ups) are supported_cards_and_currencies.
- Cancelling a transfer or transaction the customer sent is cancel_transfer; cancelling an order of goods for money back is request_refund; a payment that the app or merchant cancelled or reverted is reverted_card_payment.
- A card declined when buying something is card_not_working_declined, not a transfer problem.
